results.justification: Same defect, same root cause. Old and new both identify irr_bisect's absolute-only NPV tolerance (abs(npv) < 1e-9) with no bracket-width fallback, returning math.nan on loop exhaustion for large-magnitude cashflows even after r has converged. Current code (examples/irr.py:78-94) is unchanged from the old tree, and the new finding reproduces it empirically (NaN at 1e7+ scale). Recommendation (bracket-width exit / scale-relative tolerance) is identical.
results.currentEvidence: examples/irr.py:88 (abs(npv) < 1e-9 sole success exit), examples/irr.py:94 (return math.nan)

results.justification: Same defect, same root cause. Both flag the hard-coded bracket r_lo=-0.99 / r_hi=10.0 with no sign-change pre-check, so a root outside [-0.99, 10.0] yields NaN indistinguishable from the empty-group sentinel. Current code (examples/irr.py:80-81) is unchanged. The new finding is a superset (adds the mixed-sign/non-monotonic-NPV wrong-root case), so nothing in the old finding is left unmatched.
